title: I. Question. Whether Baptisme be necessarie to saluation, or no?

segments.text: For answer to this Question, we must rightly distinguish of necessitie. A thing is said to be necessarie two manner of waies; either absolutely and simply, or in part. Absolutely necessarie is that, which is in all respects necessarie, and the contrarie whereof is vtterly vnnecessarie. Necessarie in part is that, which in some respects, or vpon certaine causes and considerations, is necessarie. This distinction premised, I answer:
